CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[GetRelationshipDisplayValue] ( @o varchar(50), @oid int ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( select DisplayValue from dbo.Asset A cross apply [dbo].[GetObjectDisplayValueById](A.[Object],A.ObjectID) DV where @o != 'Taxonomy' and A.[Object] = @o and A.ObjectID = @oid union all select TextPath from dbo.Asset A cross apply [dbo].GetAssetTextPathById(A.ID,'/') where @o = 'Taxonomy' and A.[Object] = @o and A.ObjectID = @oid
)
